policy_title: Support Ukraine and advocate for reform of European security architecture
stated: Continue to support Ukraine against Russian invasion and work towards reform of the European security architecture and disarmament, based on democratic and inclusive values, and mutual transparency.

source.quote: The Green Party wants to see the UK: • Continue to support Ukraine as it resists Russian invasion. • Work towards reform of the European security architecture and disarmament, based on shared commitments to democracy and mutual transparency.

bearing_set.reason: Directly concerns national security, defence posture, and resilience to external threats — supporting Ukraine against Russian invasion and reshaping European security architecture squarely fits O5's scope of national security and defence.

Continued UK support for Ukraine (military aid, financial assistance — already in the billions) represents a material ongoing fiscal commitment; whether funded or borrowed, it moves the debt-path sustainability indicator.

membership_note: O9 is excluded: 'democratic values' appears as a framing/basis for the policy rather than a mechanism that moves UK domestic equal-treatment or democratic-rights indicators. O13 is excluded: European stability does affect UK prosperity but the causal chain is too indirect and long-run to earn a non-negligible verdict at this level of policy specificity.
